basis: Immutable READY fixtures, expected fields and clean/false controls; no expectation retuning
encoding_adapter: Lean Bool-list addresses become binary strings; original false/left is 0, true/right is 1. Parent-tag colors use 3*region+parent tag and may differ numerically from frozen Python IDs; equality classes must match exactly. Raw output/cut/call order and duplicate occurrences remain literal.
replacement_adapter: Known explicit control F values may be sent to compiled exchange solely in the correctness-test harness. Fprime partitions are compared structurally under block/leaf order normalization, with all raw compiled ordering retained. Runtime goodPairOutputs receives only S,T,A,B,q.
budgets: All original frozen budgets 0..q; every retained call, including pruned calls, compared against the frozen program transcription
premise_corruptions: Exactly the three immutable READY premise-corruption fixtures; no theorem coverage accepted outside the guards
